logo:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final proposed brand identity logo, PNG with genuine transparent alpha.
Brand: "Au Fil du Style", a French hair salon and barbershop in Pontchâteau. Brand is friendly, contemporary, tactile, technically precise, artistic, editorial, understated premium, not a luxury cosmetics shop. Create an ORIGINAL minimalist mark and bespoke wordmark that immediately evokes a single flowing hair strand and coiffure.
Design: One restrained continuous hairline forming an elegant open S-shaped ribbon curve, with a secondary short return subtly suggesting the letter F, an original easy-to-recognize flowing hair emblem. Only 2 flat vector-like strokes maximum; no ornate loops or detailed hair drawings. Place the emblem centered above the brand name.
Wordmark exactly "Au Fil du Style" in a beautifully drawn refined modern high-contrast serif. Distinctive slender long f ascender and the flowing curve on S create a proprietary feeling, careful optical kerning, readable capital A,F,S and otherwise lowercase. This is original logo lettering, not a generic all-caps stock wordmark. Emblem complements lettering, not enclosing it.
Small descriptor exactly "COIFFURE · PONTCHÂTEAU" beneath, in widely spaced clean uppercase sans-serif.
Color: ALL ink a single deep ink-blue #141E30, perfectly flat; no other colors. Background fully transparent. Wide balanced lockup, total composition about 1.7:1 aspect with comfortable tight clear margins. Output around 1800 px wide if possible.
No extra words, scissors, combs, crowns, leaves, gold, nail/eye icons, circle badges, salon mockup, paper, shadows, fabric, 3D, glow, gradients, watermark, white or black matte rectangle. Accents in PONTCHÂTEAU must be correct. Smooth professional curves and crisp exact lettering.

approved_study:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE exquisitely art-directed premium French hair salon FULL PAGE WEBSITE DESIGN STUDY, desktop layout shown as one tall flat high-resolution image, about 1100px wide x 3200px tall. Show the complete page from navigation to footer. No device/browser frames, no annotations or moodboard. This is proposed MODEL 1 "L'ART DU MOUVEMENT" for "Au Fil du Style", Pontchâteau.
Inputs: 1 proposed real brand logo transparent, retain its custom serif wordmark and flowing single-hair S/F emblem. 2 and 3 actual salon interior photos: preserve recognizable periwinkle blue walls, round mirrors, white counter, black chairs, honeycomb ceiling lights, wood slat entry wall. 4 actual blonde wavy hairstyle and 5 actual copper waves: use as portfolio photo crops without redesigning the hairstyles, remove screenshot UI only.
Brand palette: deep ink blue #141E30, periwinkle #A4B6E8, porcelain #F4F0E8, very sparing warm wood #B88F65. NEVER plum, pink, green, orange or gold luxury clichés.
Typography: monumental beautiful refined Bodoni-like high-contrast serif, expressive editorial typesetting, with precise Instrument Sans-style small navigation. No condensed block lettering, handwritten slogans or fake magazine covers.
The feeling is a warm, sophisticated contemporary neighbourhood hair studio seen through a cinematic fashion-art lens. Original visual hierarchy, confident scale, excellent negative space. This is not a cosmetics website, no skincare bottles, giant letters as props or model sitting in a D.
EXACT FIVE SCENES, very different compositions and heights, continuous full-width photography on all except ONE flat periwinkle interlude:
1 HERO (about 27% of page): deep ink-blue atmospheric FULL BLEED STUDIO PHOTOGRAPH, real adult woman seen from back and rear three-quarter, voluminous believable glossy blonde waves, black textured blouse, hair is the protagonist. No identifiable face required, no fake celebrity. Body and beautiful hair large on RIGHT overlap typography. A restrained open ring of cool white light arcs behind the hair, inspired by salon round mirrors and cinematic object lighting, not a sci-fi portal. Photographic light spills and true hair strand detail, no metallic statue, plastic hair or conspicuous AI. Header small logo left in porcelain; nav "Le salon · Savoir-faire · Réalisations" and neat outlined "Prendre rendez-vous" right. Hero giant serif text on LEFT, partly passing behind hair: "Le style," then italic "en mouvement." Tiny "COIFFURE & BARBIER · PONTCHÂTEAU". Small booking CTA. Elegantly composed, not a centered title over a generic portrait.
2 SALON (about 20%): actual interior photograph input 3 full-width and recognizable with blue wall, round mirrors, black chairs and wood slat entry. Strong oversized porcelain serif phrase over darker lower-left floor area "Le salon." with small line "Votre rythme." One fine line and tiny caption "6 rue Maurice Sambron · Pontchâteau". No white cards or decorative windows.
3 SERVICES (about 15%): the ONLY flat solid-colour main scene, periwinkle. Clean stunning editorial typography over large negative space, no boxes: big staggered serif "Coupe. / Couleur. / Caractère." Three restrained numbered service lines "01 Coupe & coiffage", "02 Couleur & balayage", "03 Barbe & rituels". Ink-blue text, one oversized faint hairline emblem aligned off-grid, absolutely no grids of service cards.
4 SIGNATURES (about 22%): edge-to-edge photographic composition, actual blonde waves input4 at large scale and actual copper waves input5 in a narrower vertical plane touching without white borders, hair texture fills the scene. Photographs as backgrounds, not small cards. Giant elegant porcelain serif "La couleur" and italic "a du relief." cross the photographic planes with hair/letter occlusion. Tiny "Blonds · Balayages · Nuances". Irregular continuous seam, not torn paper, collage or scrapbook.
5 BOOKING/FOOTER (about 16%): another beautiful crop of the REAL salon input2, recognizable round mirrors and periwinkle architecture, shadowed photographic backdrop with sophisticated typography "On se voit" / "au salon ?" plus clear "Prendre rendez-vous" and small "Réserver sur Planity". Footer logo and "6 rue Maurice Sambron, 44160 Pontchâteau". Keep photo full width to bottom, no separate flat footer.
All visitor copy must be FRENCH, exact clean accents and readable. No prices, ratings, invented reviews, team names, claims of awards, before/after, opening dates, fake phone or own-product line. No cliché repeated template sections, rounded cards, stock flowers, cosmetic props, taped scraps or polaroids. Precise alignment, high end web design, unusually strong connection between narrative scenes. Render as a polished proposed full-page design study.

Preserve the actual hairstyle, blonde tones, parting, wave pattern, length, shape, and blouse from input1 faithfully. Do not invent a new hair result, face, body pose or new clothes. She remains viewed from the back; NO visible face.
Remove only the original wall/room background. Remove wall and empty space in gaps around the silhouette. Keep natural fine hair edges and semi-transparent black sleeve texture. Do NOT include salon interior, window, skin retouch, title, logo or halo. Do not copy any text or background from input2.

Keep about 4% genuinely transparent safety margin at top/left/right, do not cut hair strands. Bottom can follow original torso crop. A high fidelity photographic background removal, not a new fashion photograph. Preserve real photographic grain/strand texture, no metallic/plastic hair or smooth AI curls.
Output real transparent alpha PNG with the woman's silhouette only. No white, gray, black, studio floor or checkerboard rectangle. No other elements.
